sourceBindings.text: First name the crop and growth stage. Compare affected and apparently healthy plants. Record whether the sign begins on older, lower leaves or on newer growth; whether the colour follows the midrib, outer margin or spaces between veins; and whether stems and roots look normal. Then offer a likely explanation and what might disprove it. Photograph lighting and leaf position can mislead.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
